Lessons.Title: Counting Principles
ExplanationParagraphs: Addition principle counts disjoint alternative options by summing possibilities.
Multiplication principle counts successive independent stages by multiplying counts.
Ordered k selections from n distinct items: nPk=n!/(n−k)!.
A set of n distinct items has2^n subsets including empty set.
Independent Cool-down: calculate a representative source-family example and check the result with the definition.
